RuntimeStack.Language: TypeScript; exact compiler version is owned by package.json devDependencies.
RuntimeStack.Runtime: Bun; minimum runtime is owned by package.json engines and packageManager.
RuntimeStack.CliFramework: citty for the vvoc command tree and argument parsing.
RuntimeStack.ModuleFormat: ES modules via package.json type module.

Package.Name: @osovv/vv-opencode
Package.BuildOutput: dist/ is generated by bun run build and must not be edited manually.

RuntimeDependencies.Dependency: @opencode/plugin, @opencode/client, @opencode/schema, @opencode/ai, and @opencode/protocol are all pinned to 2.0.18 for typed native plugin factories, the authenticated same-instance client, schema types, AI primitives, and protocol contracts; no @opencode-ai package remains anywhere in the dependency graph.

effect 4.0.0-rc.112 is schema-owned: @opencode/schema declares it as a peer and resolves the Effect 4 codecs used for schema-owned conversion (including context-inspection vendor schema conversion), so the direct effect pin exists to satisfy that schema contract rather than an application-level Effect stack; zod 4.1.8 is the direct runtime schema dependency.
@opentui/core, @opentui/keymap, and @opentui/solid version 0.5.12 provide native TUI rendering, keymap types, and Solid JSX integration.
solid-js version 1.9.15 is the direct peer and development contract for component-local reactive /context tab state used through @opentui/solid.
jsonc-parser for comment-tolerant config parsing and edits.
@clack/prompts for interactive init prompts and abort handling.
Supported native host window is >=2.0.18 <2.0.19, declared in package.json engines.opencode and enforced by the exact window predicate; V1 hosts and 2.0.19+ hosts are rejected.

DevelopmentDependencies.Dependency: bun-types and @types/node for runtime type surfaces.
oxlint for source linting with denied warnings.
oxfmt for source formatting and format checks.
lefthook for local pre-commit and commit-msg hooks.

OpenCode.Global: OpenCode global config stays in OpenCode-managed configuration paths.
OpenCode.Project: Project-scoped OpenCode config is managed under .opencode/ inside the selected project root.
OpenCode.NativeShape: Native 2.0.18 config uses plugins (an array of package strings or {package, options} objects), agents, skills (a string array of discovery paths), providers, and permissions; V1 plugin/agent/provider/command/small_model/tools keys are refused before mutation.
OpenCode.ModelIntent: Role intent (root model, smallModel, agents, commands) lives in the vvoc plugins entry options.modelIntent envelope; role references are never written as native model literals, and concrete selections use provider/model#variant.
OpenCode.HostWindow: The supported host window is >=2.0.18 <2.0.19 and is checked before install, init, sync, and launch writes.

Vvoc.ManagedAgents: .vvoc/agents/*.md for project-scoped managed agent prompts, with global counterparts under the vvoc config home.
Vvoc.ManagedSkills: .vvoc/skills/*/SKILL.md for project-scoped managed skills, with global counterparts under the vvoc config home.

PersistedData.WorkflowState: $XDG_DATA_HOME/vvoc/workflow/<sessionId>/workflow-state.json at snapshot version 4, which carries the common execution registry and session-wide message claims in addition to the version 3 work-item, delegated, checkpoint, and plan-run state.

Scripts.Script: Compiles TypeScript with tsconfig.build.json, recreates dist, and copies workflow system instruction markdown into dist.

Validates the expected governed src and scripts file set, required semantic block pairing, malformed hash-prefixed anchors, and exactly one current LAST_CHANGE per governed file while preserving explicit raw/declaration exceptions.
Runs typecheck, lint, fmt:check, grace:check, the read-only tool-contract coverage gate, and tests.

Runs the read-only nine-tool contract completeness gate: an independent AST census of owned registrations across src/plugins and public entry points, catalog vocabulary/dispatch/default/result checks, fixture execution through the real validators, closed-input checks, and generated-reference currency.
Regenerates templates/skills/vv-execute/references/tool-contracts.md from the pure catalog as a deliberate, reviewed step.

Runs the isolated live-host contract gate: --probe runs the minimal host-seam boundary test first, and the default full matrix exercises the freshly built dist package against local loopback OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible deterministic responders. It requires a real installed OpenCode binary inside the pinned native window (2.0.18), a current build, validated pinned native manifests with no stale @opencode-ai dependency, and the existing evidence target directory .grace/changes/active/C-OPENCODE-V2-NATIVE/; it only checks that this directory exists (it does not validate GRACE approval or accept an arbitrary bundle) and never creates the directory, writes an archive, or finalizes lifecycle state. It writes compatibility-evidence.json only on a full observed pass and sends no real provider or paid request.

Runs bun scripts/e2e-v2.ts --full, the installed-package real-host parity harness: it verifies the pinned native OpenCode 2.0.18 binary and packed artifact hashes, isolates HOME/XDG/scratch state with loopback-only providers, exercises core, full, and real-PTY TUI tiers against the installed package, and writes machine-readable parity evidence; it fails nonzero while any mandatory parity row is unverified beyond an accepted residual.
Builds dist, verifies root, server plugin, and default TUI subpath exports by importing generated files, verifies built tool-contract assets, then runs npm pack --dry-run.
Runs scripts/release-check.ts to validate package identity, package version, hosted schema id, schema config const, changelog presence, and latest changelog summary.

Runs scripts/release-bump.ts to guard a clean worktree, bump version, generate changelog, generate required AI release summary, update schema id, run release:check, create and push the release commit, dispatch and wait for exact-SHA CI publication, retry npm metadata and verify gitHead, then create the annotated tag and GitHub Release locally.

TestingStack.ModuleLevel: bun test targeted files for lib, command, plugin, workflow, secrets, hashline, and release automation modules.
TestingStack.WaveLevel: bun run typecheck, bun run lint, bun run fmt:check, bun test, bun run grace:check, and bun run contracts:check.
TestingStack.PhaseLevel: bun run check, bun run build, bun run pack:check, and bun run release:check when release or package consistency matters.
TestingStack.HostContractTesting: The agent-tool contract is proven at three distinct levels that must not be conflated: pinned native 2.0.18 schema-projection and OpenAI/Anthropic/Google schema-lowering fixtures are derived host-boundary evidence; local isolated loopback OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible responders exercise the real installed OpenCode 2.0.18 host registration, definition serialization, accepted/rejected calls, and result plumbing through the built dist package; and remote paid provider acceptance and model effectiveness are not exercised at any level. Live-host evidence is produced by observed checks only and never hand-authored, stale @opencode-ai manifests fail closed, and paid-provider effectiveness remains explicitly unverified.
TestingStack.GraceValidation: grace lint --path . and grace status --path . validate GRACE 4 artifacts using the installed stable grace binary required by AGENTS.md.

Observability.Logger: OpenCode app log through client.app.log plus bounded plugin-specific diagnostics where applicable.
Observability.LogFormat: Structured OpenCode app log bodies use service, level, and message; trace-bearing messages use [service][function][BLOCK_NAME] message.
Observability.RequiredFields: service, level, message, requestID, and sessionID when runtime context provides them.
Observability.Redaction: Never log secrets, credentials, raw tokens, or high-risk payloads outside bounded truncation policies.

OperationalConstraints.Constraint: Prefer existing project libraries and established repository patterns.
Use Bun commands for local project checks and the installed stable grace binary for GRACE lint and status, as required by AGENTS.md.
Do not edit generated dist output manually.
Root package exports and plugin subpath exports must stay valid unless an explicit breaking change is approved.

Native integration requires OpenCode >=2.0.18 <2.0.19 and a single pinned combined base package entry in the native plugins array; the host resolves that package’s ./server and ./tui exports, and no dedicated tui.json(c) registration is written.

Publishing requires an explicit exact-SHA GitHub Actions workflow dispatch; normal branch and tag pushes must not publish the package, and the release tag is created only after CI gates and npm publication succeed.
README, .grace/graph, and .grace/verification must be updated with behavior, public API, setup, command, flow, or verification changes as applicable.
